plan.change: Implement and adversarially test a trusted-base isolated new-work fast-path classifier, without activating it in privileged PR gates, to prepare safely reducing Plan Lock overhead for true staging-only prototypes.
expectedChanges: Create read-only base/head Git-tree classifier that admits only one entirely new standalone works/<slug>/ directory, created solely via regular non-executable blobs and with index.html, while rejecting updates, deletions, existing works, shared files, symlinks, large input and bad paths.
No path or output may be derived from candidate-executed code; classifier is a trusted-base tool candidate content only as read-only Git data.
Add positive and adversarial fixture tests using actual git repositories, including base/candidate SHA checks, symlink and deleted/replaced/second-work/shared paths.
Run new tests in existing read-only Change Operations Tests workflow; do not modify privileged PR gate or verification workflow in this step.
Existing PRs still require immutable first-commit Plan Lock; fast path not active until separately authorized exact-blob transitions and both trusted workflows support it.
ownerDecisions: Owner approved 2026-10-11 simplification: isolated prototypes should be light, existing/shared and public systems protected, reversions simple; CI implementation to proceed in staging only.
hqDecisions: Fail closed: only one brand-new never-present work dir and additions exclusively there; no lifecycle registry, shared engine, town root, published work or GitHub workflow changes.
Use secure trusted-base version, never run candidate JS/test or workflow in privileged context.
This PR is an independently useful validation prerequisite only; avoid changing protected exact-blob contracts and workflows until evidence proves classification.
rulesApplied: Keep existing PR Lock intact in first phase
Avoid broad glob path allowlists in gate
No publication or lifecycle status changes
No untrusted scripts in privileged checks
manualChecks: Review matcher accepts a fresh demo work and rejects old works, shared files, symlinks and deceptive path inputs
Inspect all new tests and security boundary before any gate integration
dependencies: Git CLI and Node available in GitHub Actions checkout
Workflow tests use read-only token and unchanged trusted gates
plan.rollback: Revert this isolated staging PR without affecting any production or existing gate; tool is inert until future integration.
outOfScope: Making fast path active in current trusted gates
Changing existing exact-blob registry or any public or product deployment
Automatically publishing or registering new works in town
unverified: No fast-path CI behavior claimed until integration and independent canary success
Owner iPhone confirmation irrelevant for read-only tool
alternativesRejected: Immediately bypass all existing PR gates with a filename-only check
Allow data/works.js or lifecycle modification in isolated route
Trust candidate-controlled Plan flags or workflow scripts to decide exemption
boundaryCases: Entire fresh dir only, no existing work additions
Fail closed for rename/delete/mixed PR, symlink/mode changes, odd Unicode paths, multiple works
Reject empty or oversized input and missing index.html
No modification to protected security contract in Phase 1
testPlan: Check Plan Lock first from fixed base, run trusted Scope/Risk/Impact/Static tests
Run new pure and real-git CLI adversarial fixtures plus existing Change Operations regression
Verify no current gate workflow changed and fast-path remains inactive
Consider separately staged trusted-workflow migration only after passing evidence
plan.problem: All PRs require first-commit immutable full Plan structure, even isolated new experiments; need bounded safe classification before altering privileged gates.
plan.currentContract: All PRs are mediated by base-owned pull_request_target workflows and static exact-blob contracts; unverified human review remains UNVERIFIED.
plan.whyExistingIsInsufficient: Risk policy mainly distinguishes file families and Plan labels, not provably new isolated work roots; granting light path without independent proof could exempt dangerous existing/shared changes.
plan.design: New stand-alone base/head Git-tree classifier with closed allowlist and deterministic output plus independent regression test suite, wired only to unprivileged existing test workflow.
plan.migration: Follow up with separate registry-authorized workflow updates only after deterministic positive/negative checks, while retaining old immutable Plan path for all ineligible changes.
plan.compatibility: No effective CI/security gate behavior changes in this PR; all current works and production remain unmodified.
plan.promotionRisk: Never use fast classification to authorize production or scene registration; fail closed on any non-isolated change.
